name: recalibration-invalid-cases
proves: negative contract examples for the recalibration value vocabulary (amendment section 10): list/type mismatches, date format, null members, range sanity — each with its expected authoring-time diagnostic class

cases.case: stringList payload bound to string state
cases.input: descriptor vict.catalog.select-multi outputs valueChange payload stringList; instance binds valueChange setState to state key 'team' declared type string
cases.expected: UI_COMPONENT_BINDING_INCOMPATIBLE (target state declared type string != payload stringList; no coercion)

cases.case: isoDate literal in a non-ISO format
cases.input: component node prop value = {type:'literal', value:'10/08/2026'} against an isoDate prop decl
cases.expected: rejected at authoring time by the date/time literal format rule (UI_DOC_INVALID_LITERAL scope extension: must match YYYY-MM-DD and parse via the same parser the adapter uses)

cases.case: null array member in a list state initial
cases.expected: rejected (array members may not be null; lists are JSON arrays of scalars)

cases.input: date-range instance bound to state keys rangeStart='2026-11-01', rangeEnd='2026-10-01'
cases.expected: validator-level sanity diagnostic (start > end); runtime library validation still owns user-level correction

cases.case: numberList payload bound to number state
cases.input: slider-range instance binds valueChange setState to scalar number state key 'volume'
prop value = {type:'literal', value:'25:99:00'} against an isoTime prop decl
cases.expected: rejected by the format rule (must parse as a valid time)

cases.case: mixed-member array literal is not a UiValue (repair review F-2)
cases.input: io.emit('valuesChange', ['alpha', 1]) against an output declared payload stringList
cases.expected: rejected at the emit boundary: the value is not a UiValue (homogeneous members required; no null/mixed members, amendment section 10.1a)
